title: llm.draft_editor usable when usingf the UI
body:
**What problem or use case are you trying to solve?**
Allow the use of [llm.draft_editor] when using the UI. Currently, it appears to work for a while, but then fails with "correct_num not set". Then, once set, it won't work at all. Looking through the code, it appears to me that it never intended to work while using the UI. But when it does work, it has been a real cost saver as it allows me to use two models. One model that is provides superior code, and the other that has superior reasoning. 

**Describe the UX or technical implementation you have in mind**

**Additional context**

[llm.draft_editor]
model = "openrouter/x-ai/grok-code-fast-1:floor"
api_key = "<OR key here>"
base_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"
temperature = 0.0
correct_num = 5

Model used in UI: openrouter/openai/gpt-5:floor


### If you find this feature request or enhancement useful, make sure to add a 👍 to the issue

linked_prs.title: fix(llm): support draft editor retries by adding correct_num to LLMConfig
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/openhands/core/config/llm_config.py b/openhands/core/config/llm_config.py
index ecf316319c3c..56a93d2f8558 100644
--- a/openhands/core/config/llm_config.py
+++ b/openhands/core/config/llm_config.py
@@ -95,6 +95,8 @@ class LLMConfig(BaseModel):
         description='Safety settings for models that support them (like Mistral AI and Gemini)',
     )
     for_routing: bool = Field(default=False)
+    # The number of correction attempts for the LLM draft editor
+    correct_num: int = Field(default=5)
     completion_kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None = Field(
         default=None,
         description='Custom kwargs to pass to litellm.completion',
diff --git a/openhands/runtime/utils/edit.py b/openhands/runtime/utils/edit.py
index 692f0c3acec3..7be5897ecff6 100644
--- a/openhands/runtime/utils/edit.py
+++ b/openhands/runtime/utils/edit.py
@@ -400,8 +400,8 @@ def llm_based_edit(self, action: FileEditAction, retry_num: int = 0) -> Observat
         ret_obs.llm_metrics = self.draft_editor_llm.metrics
         return ret_obs
 
-    def check_retry_num(self, retry_num):
-        correct_num = self.draft_editor_llm.config.correct_num  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    def check_retry_num(self, retry_num: int) -> bool:
+        correct_num = self.draft_editor_llm.config.correct_num
         return correct_num < retry_num
